title: Gluten-Free Crispy Pork Ribs
description: A delicious and easy-to-make recipe for crispy pork ribs, perfect for a gluten-free diet. This dish is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together almond flour, coconut sugar, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each pork rib into the beaten eggs, then coat in the almond flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated ribs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of oil and sprinkle with crispy.
Bake for 25 minutes, then increase oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
